transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we approach the event operations briefing, I need to run our standard joint operations review before I can approve the draft operating package for the Saturday evening closing concert at Riverside Park. I'd like to hear from each of you — electrical, permitting, transport, and accessibility leads — on whether you have any required changes to the current draft, which includes the diesel generator, mixed-waste bins, shuttle pickup at the West Gate every 30 minutes, and the accessible audience route from the main entrance. Please go ahead and report your areas when you're ready.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During this week's technical test, I measured the planned sound and lighting load and found that the park service can only supply 125 amps, while our draft package requires 200 amps. The good news is that a certified 180 kWh battery trailer is available and can support the full concert load — but I haven't yet added its load schedule to the operations packet. I'll need to update the package to replace or supplement the diesel generator with the battery trailer and include the load schedule before approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a required change on the permitting side. Yesterday I confirmed with the city permit office that our event permit requires all serviceware to be compostable and requires three-stream waste stations for food and beverage areas. The current draft operating package only includes mixed-waste bins, so we'll need to update that to comply with the permit conditions. I also haven't yet copied this condition into the festival's sustainability checklist, so I'll need to do that as well.

I confirmed with the transit authority this morning that the road-closure approval permits shuttle pickup only at the East Gate, with departures every 15 minutes from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The current transport sheet still shows the West Gate and 30-minute departures, so we need to update the operating package to reflect the East Gate location and the 15-minute departure schedule.

My accessibility inspection found that the accessible audience route must begin at the South Entrance and maintain a clear width of exactly 1.8 meters to the raised viewing platform.
